baseline_formula: sum(full_item_count for each admitted baseline job)
suffix_formula: sum(max(0, full_item_count - placed_before - 1) for each unique branch/repeat job)
repeat_rule: alternate OPENING then NONEMPTY queues in cycles; within each queue unseen conservative source components first, then task order, task/decision digests; first <=4 starts; each existing branch one extra repeat
repeat_deadline: before first suffix outcome; only public metadata accepted; no winner field
unused_budget: not recycled; no replacement task, seed, action, repeat or allocation transfer
